description:
Unblock WhatsApp users so they can message a channel again.

Identify each user by phone number or by BSUID; pass at least one of 'phone_numbers' and 'user_ids'.
For a user that 'list_blocked_users' shows without a phone number, pass the BSUID in 'user_ids'.

The result lists which users were unblocked and which failed with the reason.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers of the WhatsApp users to unblock, in international format without '+' or spaces, for example ['49100100200'].

user_ids.description: Business-scoped user IDs (BSUIDs) of the WhatsApp users to unblock, for users whose phone number isn't known. 'list_blocked_users' shows each blocked user's BSUID.

name: unblock_users
title: Unblock users
